descricao: Own the requested outcome, route proportionally, prepare bounded handoffs, integrate files and verify completion. Usually the main session; do not activate the whole team for trivial work.
Own complete screens, visual composition, components, interactions, responsive states and API consumption. Do not activate for server-only changes with unchanged interface contracts.
Implement business behavior, API/event contracts, persistence and integrations with relevant initial checks. Do not activate for a visual-only change served by the existing API.
Review a concrete snapshot for correctness, regressions, contract compatibility and substantive engineering risks. Start read-only and separate defects from optional improvements.
Assess applicable personal standards, language, structure, documentation and comments using traceable rules and justified exceptions. Start read-only; never invent a preference.
Select and execute meaningful boundary, failure, contract, integration and interface checks. Keep unit and integration procedures separate; do not add a QA ceremony to trivial text edits.
Maintain accurate PT-BR README, operational guides, contracts, ADRs and strategic explanations when observable behavior or operation changes. Do not write documentation for unimplemented features.

Own runtime configuration, containers, build, startup, test infrastructure and local CI setup. Follow semantic responsibility rather than configuration-file extension; do not deploy or operate GitHub.
